sentences.text:
907 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1173 Of 2019
 Vijay S/O. Babasaheb Lembhe
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra

.....
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Pande Balraj P.
 App for Respondent-State: Mr. K. D. Munde

Dated : 4th September, 2019 Per Court:-
1. Heard.
2. Notice to the respondent-State.
3. Learned A.P.P. waives notice for the respondent-State.
4. In the meanwhile, the applicant to remove office objections, if any.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant, on instructions, submits that during pendency of the application before the Court below seeking anticipatory bail, the applicant was protected by an interim order of anticipatory bail and the said order remained in force till disposal of the application.

In view of the above, until further orders, in the event of arrest of the applicant, namely, Vijay s/o Babasaheb Lembhe in connection with crime no. 180 of 2019 registered at Phulambri Police Station,
District Aurangabad (Rural) for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 of IPC and under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he be released on bail on furnishing Vijay S/O.
